shows: On Agent Platform's Responses API for Meta's Muse models, every model reads an image inline and by URL, a PDF inline and by URL, and an image in a function output. Google reads what it fetched by its content, so Muse Ember reads a PDF at an image URL and a JPEG at a file URL, and Google refuses a web page and an MP3 at either. Google refuses a URL that it cannot fetch, a file ID, a text file, audio and a PDF in a function output.
